1. PREVIOUS LOOKED GENERIC, FLAT, REPETITIVE, AND SOULESS: It used generic light cards, sterile purple headers, boring pill outlines, and lacked the tactile feel of real software and authentic school physical artifacts.

   - High-impact headline with sharp typography: "The report cards are done. You can go home now." or "Upload your Excel marksheet at 8:00 PM. Hand out 1,200 printed report cards by morning."
